name: Sila tjomnaja: Obratnaja storona skazki
source:
This is a parody of cartoons from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melnitsa_Animation_Studio]Melnitsa Animation Studio[/url].

Here is the story about a Russian boy, who purchases a pirated game and is subsequently whisked to a fantasy land. There an organization called 'Dark Force' wants to defeat Russian heroes and Tjoma accepts their contract. And his first evil deed, he decides to take the acclaimed folk hero Dobrynja's wife as his own woman.
translation:
这是对[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melnitsa_Animation_Studio]Melnitsa动画工作室[/url]作品的戏仿。

故事讲述一名俄罗斯男孩买了一款盗版游戏，随后被带到一个奇幻世界。那里有个名为“黑暗势力”的组织，想要打败俄罗斯的英雄，Tjoma接受了他们的委托。而他决定做的第一件恶事，就是将著名民间英雄多勃雷尼亚的妻子据为己有。
